title: Add suspect metric detector + guided blame playbook
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: On-call runs into cascades of related metric alerts where the root cause is a single upstream regression. This PR adds a lightweight "suspect metric" detector that groups correlated metric anomalies, ranks suspects by multi-signal evidence, and returns a guided blame playbook with suggested queries, safe mitigation steps, and context snippets for responders. The goal is to reduce cognitive load during paging and shorten time-to-identify without performing automatic remediation.

Summary of changes: single continuous change set that touches the anomaly pipeline, playbook templates, UI surface, and tests. Key components: (1) pkg/analysis/suspect_detector.go — core grouping and scoring logic (multi-signal scoring: rate change, cardinality delta, and topology correlation); (2) playbooks/templates/guided_blame.md — human-readable, structured playbook with safe remediation hints and query examples; (3) integrations/prometheus/suspect_sampler.go — sample extractor for short window queries and evidence snippets; (4) web/ui/components/SuspectCard.tsx — new oncall card rendered in incident details with collapsible evidence and suggested queries; (5) cmd/incident-bot/handler.go — incident route wiring and feature-gate check; (6) test/e2e/suspect_detector_smoke_test.go and unit tests across pkg/analysis.

Checklist: [x] core detector algorithm implemented and unit-tested, [x] template created for guided playbook, [x] UI card with feature flag implemented, [x] e2e smoke harness added against a Prometheus test fixture, [x] telemetry counters and spans added (suspect.detected, suspect.score_distribution), [x] feature-flag gating with rollout plan, [x] docs/ops playbook draft added.

Commits (high level): 
- 7a1d2f3: initial detector prototype + interfaces for metric evidence collection 
- b4c93e0: add scoring rules and correlation heuristics (cardinality + rate + tag overlap) 
- d2ff477: playbook template + human-readable remediation snippets 
- 9c4aa88: UI SuspectCard + minimal UX polish 
- f11b22a: add e2e smoke test and prometheus fixture; fix flaky timing in detector tests 
- 0e3b9c6: telemetry, feature flag, and docs updates 

Files changed (high level): pkg/analysis/suspect_detector.go, pkg/analysis/suspect_detector_test.go, integrations/prometheus/suspect_sampler.go, playbooks/templates/guided_blame.md, web/ui/components/SuspectCard.tsx, web/ui/styles/suspect.css, cmd/incident-bot/handler.go, cmd/incident-bot/flags.go, test/e2e/suspect_detector_smoke_test.go, docs/ops/suspect_playbook.md, internal/telemetry/metrics.go, go.mod, package.json, yarn.lock

Testing notes: Unit coverage added for scoring boundary conditions and false-positive suppression heuristics (minimum evidence threshold, topology-match). e2e smoke simulates twin metric spikes across two services and asserts the detector surfaces the correct suspect with a score > 0.75 and that the generated playbook contains at least two suggested queries. CI initially failed on lint and a flaky timing assertion; fixed by stable time mocking and adding explicit backoff in the e2e fixture.

Rollout plan: Feature-gated behind 'suspect_blame_v1'. Start with opt-in for SRE and internal teams, monitor suspect.detected rate and score_distribution. If noise > 3x baseline, auto-disable for rollout cohort and run a postmortem. Will expose a toggle in Redwood Console's oncall settings.

Backward compatibility and safety: No automated remediation is included. Output is purely advisory; playbook templates explicitly label confidence and safety level. Data sampling adheres to existing telemetry PII redaction rules; the sampler scrubs label values flagged by the redaction list.

Related: ENG-1297 (design), SRE-443 (threshold tuning), SUP-781 (customer-reported noisy-correlated-alerts).

release_notes: Adds an advisory 'Suspect metric detector' that surfaces correlated metric anomalies and a guided blame playbook in incident detail views. Feature is behind a tenant-level feature flag and initially opt-in for internal teams. No automatic remediation included.
